title: Complaints and plan
question: Do the things people complain about depend on which plan they are on?
about: Twenty-four support tickets and the plan each one came from. A second study, written to use the same six primitives in a different arrangement: one reading per ticket instead of two, no second source gathered in parallel, and no retry — the vocabulary travels, the shape does not have to.

settings.name: sample_size
settings.label: Tickets read
settings.note: The tickets are short, so this study is the cheap one to try a real model on.

types.ticket: one support ticket, as it was written
types.theme: one short label for what a ticket is about
types.verdict: whether one theme appears in one ticket
